items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: he was pretty close with Ravel

ctx.x: Oh that one, for sure. And I even thought like you know when I had some grandiose ideas like there should be a movie of this opening night or whatever, and I think there is one

from the last ten or so years, there is some fictionalized movie of that opening night, but I thought what an amazing thing to be part of. But I think on the other level you know supposedly he took the four-hand thing to Debussy’s house and Debussy sight read so I mean that was the level, the level was insane. Plus there’s some stuff that Stravinsky really gets from Ravel that are in “The Rite of Spring.” There’s a piece called Alborada del Gracioso that Ravel did in 1905, and I’m convinced that had to be under…
I had the good fortune to interview Chubby Jackson. And he talked about that, that session, trying to play and Stravinsky’s up there. They were so, I think, challenged by that experience.
